claims.claim: KL decomposes exactly into the binary H versus H-complement divergence plus two conditional divergences.
A copied agent supplies no independent confidence gain.
Two separate verification processes pay the fixed setup burden twice, while one shared process pays it once.
Monitoring interval and response latency add to the blind stewardship window.
Paired coverage equals p+q-r by definition.
The opposing corners attain the two endpoint expressions.
Declared fixed overheads compose additively; the exact boundary witness attains four modeled units.
A feasible additive ledger bounds the sum of two delegated work allocations by the budget remaining after the audit reserve.
A feasible additive joint ledger bounds the sum of two application workloads by the budget remaining after one shared-interface charge.

trivial_targets.name: kl_chain_rule_habitable_partition
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem kl_chain_rule_habitable_partition
    (q alpha withinH withinC : ℝ) :
    partitionLedger q alpha withinH withinC =
      binaryKL q alpha + q * withinH + (1 - q) * withinC

trivial_targets.name: bundled_cost_expansion
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem bundled_cost_expansion (fixed v1 v2 : ℝ) :
    bundledCost fixed v1 v2 = fixed + v1 + v2

trivial_targets.name: blind_window_definition
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem blind_window_definition (monitorDelay responseDelay : ℝ) :
    blindWindow monitorDelay responseDelay = monitorDelay + responseDelay

trivial_targets.name: coverage_definition
trivial_targets.signature: theorem coverage_definition (p q overlap : ℝ) : coverage p q overlap = p + q - overlap

trivial_targets.name: process_cost_decomposition
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem process_cost_decomposition (units unitCost overhead : ℝ) :
    processCost units unitCost overhead = overhead + units * unitCost

trivial_targets.name: delegated_cost_decomposition
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem delegated_cost_decomposition (firstWork secondWork auditReserve : ℝ) :
    delegatedCost firstWork secondWork auditReserve =
      auditReserve + firstWork + secondWork

trivial_targets.name: joint_cost_decomposition
trivial_targets.signature:
theorem joint_cost_decomposition (leftWork rightWork sharedInterface : ℝ) :
    jointCost leftWork rightWork sharedInterface =
